Katahdin.notes: Gold standard hair sheep. Parasite resistant. Developed by Michael Piel from St Croix/Suffolk/Wiltshire.

Black Headed Dorper.notes: Hair sheep. FL Dorper are small-framed (~80% of standard). Meat breed.

St Augustine.notes: HAIR sheep — Florida native. Heat/parasite adapted.

American Black Belly.notes: Hair sheep. Small frame. Excellent parasite resistance.

Barbados Black Belly.notes: Hair sheep. Foundation of many hair breeds.

Wiltshire Horn.notes: Hair/shedding sheep. Used in Katahdin development.

Gulf Coast Native.notes: HAIR sheep — SE US native. Extreme parasite resistance. Florida adapted.

St Croix.notes: Hair sheep. Caribbean origin. Foundation of Katahdin.

Suffolk.notes: Wool. Terminal meat sire. Big lambs, dystocia risk.

East Friesian.notes: Wool. Dairy breed. High milk production.

Southdown.notes: Wool. Babydoll type. Compact meat breed.

Cracker.notes: Florida native. SHEDS in warm climate despite not being classified as hair. Parasite resistant. Heritage.

Tunis.notes: Wool. Fat-tailed. Good mothering. Heat tolerant for a wool breed.

Awassi.notes: Wool. Fat-tailed dairy breed. Middle East origin. Heat tolerant.
